## Runtime limitations

<a id="agent.post-output-exit"></a>
### `agent.post-output-exit` — Post-output process exit wait

Status: active; enforcement: runtime; observed CAFE: 0.7.2.

Lifecycle: introduced=unknown, changed=unknown, resolved=N/A.
Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

- Scope: `{"operations":["managed"],"capabilities":["long-command"]}`. exit-wait=300 seconds; Wait starts after stdout consumption; timeout terminates with bounded kill cleanup. Existing terminal-evidence success rules remain.

Trigger: Stdout consumption finishes but process remains alive.
Impact: Process is terminated after exit wait.

Detection: post_output timeout diagnostics.
Sources: [src/cafe/agents/executor.py](../src/cafe/agents/executor.py)

Mitigation: Ensure children close stdout and exit; verify explicit completion and exit status.
Escalation: Record interruption evidence and request bounded recovery through existing routes.
Permission boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

<a id="agent.stdout-idle"></a>
### `agent.stdout-idle` — Agent stdout idle watchdog

Status: active; enforcement: runtime; observed CAFE: 0.7.2.

Lifecycle: introduced=unknown, changed=unknown, resolved=N/A.
Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

- Scope: `{"clis":["codex","claude","copilot","cursor-agent"],"platforms":["linux","darwin"],"operations":["managed"],"capabilities":["long-command"]}`. idle=300 seconds; Elapsed > threshold; only CAFE-read stdout lines or drained supported native activity reset idle time. Stderr and unseen tool output do not. Activity is not completion.

- Scope: `{"clis":["gemini"],"platforms":["linux","darwin"],"operations":["managed"],"capabilities":["long-command"]}`. idle=600 seconds; Elapsed > threshold; only CAFE-read stdout lines or drained supported native activity reset idle time. Stderr and unseen tool output do not. Activity is not completion.

Trigger: Managed CLI stops producing observed activity.
Impact: CAFE terminates a quiet subprocess.

Detection: Idle diagnostics and observed stdout/native activity timestamps.
Sources: [src/cafe/agents/executor.py](../src/cafe/agents/executor.py); [src/cafe/agents/cli/codex_stream_activity.py](../src/cafe/agents/cli/codex_stream_activity.py)

Mitigation: Split work within the threshold or verify progress reaches CAFE stdout/supported native activity; preserve child exit status and separate completion evidence. Unseen background terminal output is insufficient.
Escalation: Declare constraint_assistance before starting work without observable progress.
Permission boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

<a id="execution.primary-only-chain"></a>
### `execution.primary-only-chain` — Configured chain boundary

Status: active; enforcement: runtime; observed CAFE: 0.7.2.

Lifecycle: introduced=unknown, changed=unknown, resolved=N/A.
Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

- Scope: `{"operations":["managed"],"consumers":["single-chain"]}`. A single-entry chain has no backup; failure is re-raised. Only explicitly configured multi-entry chains allow existing fallback behavior.

Trigger: Primary fails and no fallback entry exists.
Impact: Execution stops for a decision.

Detection: Inspect configured chain and failed attempt evidence.

Mitigation: Do not infer or append backups; retain the confirmed chain.

Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

- Scope: `{"consumers":["callback"]}`. Session/dispatch locks confer no worker PID registry, cancellation authority or safe workflow-worker stop channel.

Impact: Inferred process control can target the wrong worker.

Mitigation: Refresh worker state and use existing authorized control paths; never kill an inferred PID.
Escalation: Escalate worker control through existing authority.
Permission boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.
